primary_baseline.attribution: Exact query aggregate across all pages/countries/devices except explicit source filters. Separate workbook tabs cannot be joined.

latest_available_exact_query_rows.attribution: Exact query aggregate across all pages/countries/devices except explicit source filters. Separate workbook tabs cannot be joined.

evidence_limits.exact_query_by_page: VERIFIED LIVE. Exact query 20 September–17 October 2026, Pages tab and UAE+exact hub filters inspected directly. See live-gsc-evidence.json.
evidence_limits.exact_query_uae: VERIFIED LIVE. Exact query + United Arab Emirates. 179 impressions, 2 clicks, average position 12.2 shown. Do not confuse with all-country baseline.
evidence_limits.exact_query_mobile_desktop: VERIFIED LIVE. Query + UAE + exact target hub: Desktop 100 impressions/2 clicks/11.2 position; Mobile 61/0/11.3. Device and page metrics jointly filtered, not allocated from independent tabs.
evidence_limits.google_selected_canonical: VERIFIED indexed URL Inspection. Google-selected canonical = Inspected URL, exact target hub. Page indexed, fetch/crawl/indexing allowed. Last crawl displayed 16 Oct 2026 21:18:38, timezone not exposed.
evidence_limits.actual_query_landing_page: VERIFIED LIVE. Intended hub 164 impressions/2 clicks globally; 161/2 for UAE, current 28-day exact query. Dominant observed owner, not exclusive across all time.
evidence_limits.latest_range: Latest available workbook digitecme.com-Performance-on-Search-2026-10-20.xlsx, period 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-17. Filename is not reporting period.
evidence_limits.source_missing_rows: Absent from visible exported query rows means unavailable, never zero demand.
evidence_limits.overlap: Date windows overlap and duplicate exports exist. No observation totals pooled and no causal trend inferred.
evidence_limits.position: GSC average position 13.88 is an aggregate historical metric; not current Dubai rank, rank on every impression or evidence of top three.
evidence_limits.conversion: GSC clicks do not establish qualified enquiries or bookings.
evidence_limits.release_effect: Unknown. Current 28-day report ends 17 October; indexed crawl dated 16 October. Latest live provisional 24-hour span 19–20 October contains only four impressions. No release causation inferred.

access_check.initial_browser_inventory: Only in-app browser and MCP Apps surfaces, initially both with zero tabs. Live owned-site GSC card later found by SERP agent, read-only follow-up pending.

live_evidence.method: Authenticated Google Search Console read-only browser UI. Report filters, rendered tables and indexed URL Inspection observed directly. No request indexing, live URL test, property change or external account mutation.

period.date_basis: GSC daily report dates, retained exactly as shown; not relabelled as Dubai daily dates.

indexed_url_inspection.last_crawl_timezone: Not exposed in captured UI. Do not assign Dubai or UTC to the displayed timestamp.
enhancements: HTTPS Page is served over HTTPS

latest_24h_provisional.exact_hour_boundaries: Not exposed in captured chart description. Do not claim a particular Dubai start/end hour.
latest_24h_provisional.interpretation: Four provisional impressions cannot establish a ranking trend, release impact, a stable current rank or top-three visibility.

interpretation.ownership: Intended brand hub is directly verified as the dominant exact-query owner in the current 28-day report and the sole owner in the four-impression provisional latest 24-hour sample.
interpretation.mobile: Zero mobile clicks on 61 UAE hub impressions is observed. It is an early conversion/snippet investigation opportunity, not proof of a mobile UX defect or a statistically established CTR deficit.
interpretation.overlap: Other pages appearing for the same query warrants intent and internal-link review. It does not prove harmful cannibalization or justify removing distinct oil/brake owners.
interpretation.release: The 28-day reporting period ends 17 October 2026 and the indexed crawl is dated 16 October. Neither verifies the effect of the 19 October releases or this unpublished 20 October candidate.
interpretation.ranking_goal: No verified top-three result or guarantee. Average position is an aggregate across impressions and different SERP contexts.

live_evidence.source_export_note: The newly supplied 20 October workbook has a contains-query filter and one visible exact-query row. Its headline and page/country/device metrics match the independently observed live Exact query report at UI precision. Keep the file's contains scope distinct from the live exact-filter proof.
